component.name: SafeSign IC
component.summary: SafeSign IC token driver for Tessera
Driver de tokens SafeSign IC para o Tessera

description.p: SafeSign IC is the PKCS#11 driver for GD Burti (G+D StarSign) tokens and other SafeSign tokens and cards. Tessera loads it like any other driver, so browsers, PDF readers and document signers that use Tessera's tokens can sign with them.
It also adds SafeSign's Token Administration to Tessera's window, to change and unlock the PIN.

This extension installs A.E.T. Europe's official Linux packages, downloaded from the vendor at install time and checked against pinned checksums. Only their files are taken: no install script runs. SafeSign is closed source and not made or endorsed by Tessera's author.
The driver runs inside Tessera's sandbox with Tessera's permissions and has none of its own. After installing it, use Restart Tessera in Tessera's menu.
